signs.text: BRYN CELLI DDU. Welsh for the Mound in the Dark Grove: a passage tomb on Anglesey, built about five thousand years ago. At the midsummer sunrise the light runs down the passage into the chamber.

text: Stone on stone, fitted without a scrap of mortar. Whoever built this was in no hurry, and expected it to be there a while.
At the end of the passage the chamber is cold and quiet. At the midsummer sunrise a bar of light runs down the passage and lands about here.
It has done this for about five thousand years, whether or not anyone was watching.
